newsitem.title: UK: MAM at record amid rising UK shares.
newsitem.headline: MAM at record amid rising UK shares.

text.p: Shares in British fund manager Mercury Asset Management Plc rose to a record high on Monday, reflecting recent strength in UK financial markets and amid speculation it could be added to the FTSE 100 next month, traders said.
The stock was up 36p at 11.96 stg by 1215 GMT in moderate volume of 282,793 shares, after earlier rising as high as 12.00 stg -- beating its previous peak of 11.70 stg set November 14.
Traders said the rise mostly reflected recent gains in UK shares, with the FTSE 100 up 36.0 points at 4,054.7 by 1311 GMT after on Friday recording its biggest one-day gain in 16 months.
A rising market boosts the value of MAM's investments as well as attracting more cash into the market.

"It is quite a market-sensitive stock," said one marketmaker at a leading brokerage. The FTSE membership committee next meets on December 11 and MAM will join the benchmark UK index if its market capitalisation is large enough.
